proof:
Source: Simon, Introduction to Geometric Measure Theory, Ch. 8, 3.4 (printed p. 211): the Λ = 0 case of 3.3, obtained “by essentially the same computation as in §4 of Ch. 4” (Ch. 4, 3.1–3.6) with the radial test field X_y = γ(r)(y − x). The argument below is extracted from the parent node's accepted proof (its common radial computation and its Part B) with all details filled in; it is self-contained. Errata/normalisations: (i) 3.4 needs no locally-bounded-first-variation hypothesis, only stationarity in B°_{ρ0}(x); (ii) the printed subtraction is written additively in [0,∞], which is equivalent because all terms are finite. Implementation note: the SimonGMT modules cited below (Chapter08/StationaryMonotonicity.lean, StationaryCutoff.lean, WeightedRadialIdentity.lean, RadialCutoffDifferentiation.lean, RadialFirstVariation.lean, Chapter04/FirstVariation.lean) are all imported by Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter08.StationaryMonotonicity, which the frozen contract does not import; an implementation file may import it.

Notation. Fix N, n, U, V, x, ρ0 as in the statement, with the stationarity hypothesis (H): V.firstVariation X = 0 for every test field X ∈ K(U;ℝ^N) (Varifold.TestVectorField U) with tsupport X ⊆ ball x ρ0. U is open (V.isOpen_domain). μ := V.weight (μ(A) = V(A × G) for Borel A); G := G(N,n) = Grassmannian N n; p_S := Grassmannian.project S and p_{S⊥}(v) := v − p_S(v); B_s := closedBall x s; B°_s := ball x s; ω_n := unitBallVolume n. For (y,S) put g(y,S) := |p_{S⊥}(|y − x|^{-1}(y − x))|² ∈ [0,1], with 0^{-1} = 0 so that g(x,S) = 0 (SimonGMT S.radialNormalSq x y, Chapter08/RadialFirstVariation.lean:109). For t > 0 put P(t) := μ(B_t)/ofReal(t^n) (SimonGMT Varifold.normalizedBallMass V x t, StationaryMonotonicity.lean:111), and let f(y,S) := ofReal(|p_{S⊥}(y − x)|²/|y − x|^{n+2}) be the integrand of normalDefect V x, so normalDefect V x A = ∫_{A×G} f dV.

Step 0 (preliminaries).
0.1 For 0 < s < ρ0, B_s ⊆ B°_{ρ0} ⊆ U and B_s is compact, so V(B_s × G) = μ(B_s) < ∞ (V.finite_on_compact) and P(s) < ∞.
0.2 0 < ω_n < ∞ (the open unit ball of EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) is nonempty, open and bounded, and volume is an additive Haar measure: measure_ball_pos, measure_ball_lt_top; ω_0 = 1). For t > 0, ofReal(t)^n = ofReal(t^n) (ENNReal.ofReal_pow) and densityRatio n μ x t = μ(B_t)/(ω_n·ofReal(t)^n) = ω_n^{-1}·P(t) (ENNReal.mul_inv, using ω_n ≠ 0, ∞).
0.3 For every (y,S): |p_{S⊥}(y − x)|²/|y − x|^{n+2} = g(y,S)/|y − x|^n. For y ≠ x, homogeneity gives |p_{S⊥}(y − x)|² = |y − x|²·g(y,S) (Grassmannian.normalProject_eq_sub and Grassmannian.norm_normalProject_radial_sq, RadialFirstVariation.lean:81,123); for y = x both sides are 0 (Lean's 0/0 = 0, g(x,S) = 0). Hence f(y,S) = ofReal(g(y,S)/|y − x|^n), f(x,S) = 0, and normalDefect V x A = ∫_{A×G} ofReal(g/|y − x|^n) dV for every set A; in particular normalDefect V x (B_ρ ∖ B_σ) equals SimonGMT's Varifold.annularMonotonicityDefect V x σ ρ (StationaryMonotonicity.lean:120).
0.4 For 0 < R < ρ0: B_R ⊆ B°_{ρ0} ⊆ U, and every test field X with tsupport X ⊆ B°_R also has tsupport X ⊆ B°_{ρ0}, so δV(X) = 0 by (H); that is, V is StationaryOn (ball x R) in the sense of SimonGMT (Chapter08/StationaryCutoff.lean:28).

Step 1 (the annular identity). For 0 < σ ≤ ρ < ρ0:
   P(σ) + normalDefect V x (B_ρ ∖ B_σ) = P(ρ).        (1)
Let R := (ρ + ρ0)/2 ∈ (ρ, ρ0); by 0.1 and 0.4, B_R ⊆ U, V(B_R × G) < ∞, and δV vanishes on test fields supported in B°_R. (Formal shortcut: (1) is SimonGMT Varifold.StationaryOn.stationaryMonotonicity, StationaryMonotonicity.lean:131, applied with this R, after rewriting normalizedBallMass and annularMonotonicityDefect by 0.2–0.3; its proof is the following computation.)
1.1 Cutoffs and fields. For ε > 0 let φ_ε := monotonicityCutoff ε (SimonGMT Chapter04/FirstVariation.lean:825): C¹, antitone (so φ_ε' ≤ 0), with values in [0,1], equal to 1 on (−∞,1] and to 0 on [1+ε, ∞). For t > 0 let c_t(y) := φ_ε(|y − x|²/t²) ∈ [0,1], ċ_t(y) := ∂_t c_t(y) = (−2|y − x|²/t³)·φ_ε'(|y − x|²/t²) ≥ 0, and X_t(y) := c_t(y)·(y − x) (SimonGMT scaledRadialCutoff, scaledRadialCutoffDeriv, weightedRadialVectorField x (fun _ ↦ 1) φ_ε t). If c_t(y) ≠ 0 then |y − x| < √(1+ε)·t ≤ (1+ε)t, so tsupport X_t ⊆ B_{(1+ε)t} (weightedRadialVectorField_support); if ċ_t(y) ≠ 0 then t ≤ |y − x| ≤ (1+ε)t, since φ_ε is locally constant on (−∞,1) and on ((1+ε)², ∞) (scaledRadialCutoffDeriv_support); X_t is C¹ with compact support (contDiff_weightedRadialVectorField); ċ_t ≥ 0 (scaledRadialCutoffDeriv_nonneg). (All objects depend on ε; the dependence is suppressed until 1.6.)
1.2 Fix ε > 0 with (1+ε)ρ < R and let t ∈ [σ, ρ]; then (1+ε)t < R. Put I(t) := ∫ c_t dV = ∫ c_t dμ, J(t) := ∫ c_t g dV, q(y,S) := g(y,S)/max(σ, |y − x|)^n ∈ [0, σ^{-n}] (SimonGMT truncatedRadialDefect x σ, StationaryCutoff.lean:121) and G(t) := ∫ c_t q dV. Differentiation under the integral sign: for t' in a compact neighbourhood [t1,t2] of t with t1 > 0 and (1+ε)t2 < R, the integrands and their t'-derivatives vanish off B_R × G and are bounded there by a constant (ċ_{t'}(y) is jointly continuous in (t',y)), and V(B_R × G) < ∞; hence I'(t) = ∫ ċ_t dV, J'(t) = ∫ ċ_t g dV and G'(t) = ∫ ċ_t q dV, all integrands being V-integrable (SimonGMT Varifold.hasDerivAt_integral_radialCutoff_of_radius, RadialCutoffDifferentiation.lean:91, with A = 1 + ε).
1.3 The radial identity. For all (y,S), div_S X_t(y) = n·c_t(y) − t·ċ_t(y) + t·ċ_t(y)·g(y,S): with η(τ) := φ_ε(τ/t²), DX_t = η(|y − x|²)·Id + 2η'(|y − x|²)·(y − x)⊗(y − x), trace(p_S DX_t) = n·η + 2η'·|p_S(y − x)|², |p_S(y − x)|² = |y − x|²(1 − g) by 0.3, and 2η'(|y − x|²)|y − x|² = −t·ċ_t(y) (SimonGMT tangentialDivergence_weightedRadialVectorField, WeightedRadialIdentity.lean:44, with h ≡ 1). Integrating against V gives δV(X_t) = n·I(t) − t·I'(t) + t·J'(t), hence (I/t^n)'(t) = I'(t)/t^n − n·I(t)/t^{n+1} = J'(t)/t^n − δV(X_t)/t^{n+1} (SimonGMT hasDerivAt_normalized_weightedCutoffMass, WeightedRadialIdentity.lean:200, h ≡ 1). Since tsupport X_t ⊆ B_{(1+ε)t} ⊆ B°_R ⊆ U, X_t is a test field in K(U;ℝ^N) supported in B°_R, so δV(X_t) = 0 by 0.4, and therefore
   (I/t^n)'(t) = J'(t)/t^n        (SimonGMT StationaryOn.hasDerivAt_normalizedCutoffMass, StationaryCutoff.lean:39).
1.4 Two-sided comparison. Pointwise ċ_t q ≤ ċ_t g/t^n ≤ (1+ε)^n·ċ_t q: where ċ_t(y) ≠ 0 we have σ ≤ t ≤ |y − x| ≤ (1+ε)t, so q = g/|y − x|^n and |y − x|^{-n} ≤ t^{-n} ≤ (1+ε)^n·|y − x|^{-n}, while ċ_t, g ≥ 0; where ċ_t(y) = 0 all three vanish (SimonGMT Varifold.scaledRadialCutoffDeriv_defect_bounds, StationaryCutoff.lean:142). Integrating, G'(t) ≤ J'(t)/t^n ≤ (1+ε)^n·G'(t).
1.5 Integration over [σ, ρ]. The functions t ↦ I(t)/t^n and t ↦ G(t) are differentiable at every t ∈ [σ, ρ]. By 1.3–1.4, t ↦ I(t)/t^n − G(t) and t ↦ (1+ε)^n G(t) − I(t)/t^n have nonnegative derivatives on [σ, ρ], so by the mean value theorem (Mathlib monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg on Icc σ ρ) they are non-decreasing there, i.e.
   G_ε(ρ) − G_ε(σ) ≤ I_ε(ρ)/ρ^n − I_ε(σ)/σ^n ≤ (1+ε)^n·(G_ε(ρ) − G_ε(σ))
(SimonGMT StationaryOn.cutoff_squeeze, StationaryCutoff.lean:188).
1.6 ε ↓ 0. For t ∈ {σ, ρ}, c_t → 1_{B_t} pointwise as ε → 0+ (if |y − x| ≤ t it is 1 for all ε; if |y − x| > t it is 0 once 1 + ε ≤ |y − x|²/t²), with |c_t| ≤ 1_{B_R×G} and |c_t q| ≤ σ^{-n}·1_{B_R×G} once (1+ε)t < R; by dominated convergence I_ε(t) → μ(B_t) and G_ε(t) → ∫_{B_t×G} q dV (SimonGMT Varifold.tendsto_cutoffMass and Varifold.tendsto_integral_radialCutoff, StationaryCutoff.lean:111 and 63), and (1+ε)^n → 1. The squeeze in 1.5 yields the real identity
   μ(B_ρ)/ρ^n − μ(B_σ)/σ^n = ∫_{B_ρ×G} q dV − ∫_{B_σ×G} q dV = ∫_{(B_ρ∖B_σ)×G} g(y,S)/|y − x|^n dV(y,S),
because q is V-integrable on B_ρ × G, B_σ × G ⊆ B_ρ × G, and on the annulus |y − x| > σ, so q = g/|y − x|^n there (SimonGMT StationaryOn.stationaryMonotonicity_real, StationaryMonotonicity.lean:52).
1.7 The right-hand side is ≥ 0 and all terms are finite (0.1), so applying ofReal (additive on nonnegative reals) gives P(σ) + ∫_{(B_ρ∖B_σ)×G} ofReal(g/|y − x|^n) dV = P(ρ): indeed ofReal(μ(B_t).toReal/t^n) = μ(B_t)/ofReal(t^n) = P(t) (ofReal_div_of_pos, ofReal_toReal), and the Bochner integral of the nonnegative V-integrable function g/|y − x|^n over the annulus equals the toReal of its lintegral (ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal). By 0.3 that lintegral is normalDefect V x (B_ρ ∖ B_σ), which proves (1).

Step 2 (existence of the density). By (1) and normalDefect ≥ 0, P(σ) ≤ P(ρ) whenever 0 < σ ≤ ρ < ρ0, i.e. P is monotone on (0, ρ0). Hence P(t) → L := inf{P(s) : s ∈ (0, ρ0)} as t → 0+ (Mathlib MonotoneOn.tendsto_nhdsWithin_Ioo_right, Topology/Order/Monotone.lean:457; alternatively SimonGMT StationaryOn.tendsto_normalizedBallMass_atRight with any R ∈ (0, ρ0), StationaryMonotonicity.lean:174), and L ≤ P(ρ0/2) < ∞. Put θ := ω_n^{-1}·L. For t > 0, densityRatio n μ x t = ω_n^{-1}·P(t) (0.2), and multiplication by the finite constant ω_n^{-1} is continuous on [0,∞] (ENNReal.Tendsto.const_mul), so densityRatio n μ x t → ω_n^{-1}·L = θ as t → 0+, i.e. HasDensity n μ x θ.

Step 3 (σ ↓ 0). Fix ρ ∈ (0, ρ0). For k ∈ ℕ let σ_k := ρ/(k+1) ∈ (0, ρ] and A_k := B_ρ ∖ B_{σ_k}.
3.1 (A_k) is increasing (σ_k decreases), and ⋃_k A_k = B_ρ ∖ {x}: x ∉ A_k for every k, and if y ∈ B_ρ, y ≠ x, then |y − x| > σ_k for all large k.
3.2 For measurable A, normalDefect V x A = ∫_{A×G} f dV = (V.measure.withDensity f)(A × G) (MeasureTheory.withDensity_apply). The measurable sets A_k × G increase to (B_ρ ∖ {x}) × G, so by continuity from below (MeasureTheory.tendsto_measure_iUnion_atTop) normalDefect V x A_k → normalDefect V x (B_ρ ∖ {x}) as k → ∞.
3.3 normalDefect V x (B_ρ ∖ {x}) = normalDefect V x (B_ρ): B_ρ × G is the disjoint union of the measurable sets (B_ρ ∖ {x}) × G and {x} × G, and on {x} × G the integrand is f(x,S) = ofReal(|0 − p_S(0)|²/|0|^{n+2}) = ofReal(0/0) = 0, so the second piece contributes 0.
3.4 By (1), P(σ_k) + normalDefect V x A_k = P(ρ) for every k. As k → ∞, σ_k → 0 with σ_k > 0, so P(σ_k) → L by Step 2, and normalDefect V x A_k → normalDefect V x (B_ρ) by 3.2–3.3. Addition on [0,∞] is continuous, so the constant sequence P(ρ) converges to L + normalDefect V x (B_ρ); by uniqueness of limits, L + normalDefect V x (B_ρ) = P(ρ).
3.5 Multiplying by ω_n^{-1} and using left distributivity and 0.2: θ + ω_n^{-1}·normalDefect V x (B_ρ) = ω_n^{-1}·P(ρ) = densityRatio n μ x ρ.

Step 4 (conclusion). θ satisfies HasDensity n μ x θ (Step 2) and θ + ω_n^{-1}·normalDefect V x (closedBall x ρ) = densityRatio n μ x ρ for every 0 < ρ < ρ0 (Step 3). Since N, n, U, V, x, ρ0 were arbitrary, StationaryMonotonicityIdentity holds. Nothing above uses n ≥ 1 or any first-variation bound (for n = 0 the integrand is 1 off the centre and the identity reads μ({x}) + μ(B_ρ ∖ {x}) = μ(B_ρ)).
key_steps: Preliminaries: μ_V(B_s(x)) < ∞ for s < ρ0; 0 < ω_n < ∞; densityRatio = ω_n^{-1}·P with P(t) = μ_V(B_t)/ofReal(t^n); normalDefect integrand = ofReal(g/r^n) everywhere (0 at y = x), so normalDefect on annuli is SimonGMT annularMonotonicityDefect; V is StationaryOn (ball x R) for every R < ρ0.

Annular identity P(σ) + normalDefect V x (B_ρ∖B_σ) = P(ρ) for 0 < σ ≤ ρ < ρ0: radial cutoff fields supported in ball x R have δV = 0, so d/dt(I/t^n) = J'/t^n; two-sided cutoff squeeze G' ≤ J'/t^n ≤ (1+ε)^n G'; integrate on [σ,ρ]; ε ↓ 0 (SimonGMT StationaryOn.stationaryMonotonicity with R = (ρ+ρ0)/2).
P is monotone on (0,ρ0), so L = lim_{t↓0} P(t) = inf P exists and is finite; θ := ω_n^{-1}·L satisfies HasDensity n μ_V x θ.

With σ_k = ρ/(k+1): normalDefect V x (B_ρ∖B_{σ_k}) ↑ normalDefect V x (B_ρ∖{x}) = normalDefect V x (B_ρ) (continuity from below; centre integrand 0); pass to the limit in the annular identity and multiply by ω_n^{-1}.
